title: How c Affects Convergence
text: Since $$f(x)=x^2-4$$, the iteration is $$x_{n+1}=x_n-c\,(x_n**2-4)$$ . Starting from $$x_0=0$$, compute a few iterations for different values of c. For example, $$c=0.25$$ gives $$0$$, $$1$$, $$1.75$$, $$1.984$$, ... which approaches the root $$2$$, while $$c=1$$ gives $$0$$, $$4$$, $$-8$$, $$-68$$, ... which does not converge.
